name: Cha Chaan Teng Rush
pitch: Run the kitchen of a Hong Kong cha chaan teng through a 12-minute rush, then build the shop up between days.
problem: Hong Kong menus make more sense once you've cooked them.

stats.label: restaurants: diner, dim sum and a counter
levels, with a new dish at each one after 1

features.title: Dim Sum Rush
features.text: A Sunday-morning 酒樓, where finished baskets ride a trolley that holds eight.
details: Waiters push the trolley to the tables
A full trolley sheds its oldest unwanted basket

screen.alt: Dim Sum Rush: a red and gold dining room, steamer baskets on the counters and tickets for har gow and siu mai

features.title: Counter Rush
features.text: One counter: drinks, buns, toast and noodles, served against the clock.
details: Six days, then 搏命 Do or Die, an endless shift
A difficulty slider from relaxed to frantic

screen.alt: Counter Rush's day picker: six days from opening day to a rainy day crowd, Do or Die, and a difficulty slider

features.title: Build the shop
features.text: Spend the takings on furniture, a bigger room and faster appliances.
details: From 奶油多 toast to 乾炒牛河 beef chow fun
Relaxed days at level 10, to build at your own pace

features.title: Learn the words
features.text: Learning mode puts Cantonese and Jyutping on every ticket.
details: Customers say their whole order: 唔該，兩籠蝦餃！
Serve a dish six times and its picture drops off

screens.alt: Cha Chaan Teng Rush mid-morning: an isometric diner with customers ordering pineapple buns and milk tea, tickets on the rail and stock levels
screens.caption: Day 1, just after opening

facts.builtWith: Plain JS, every pixel in code
